Halal meal plans in Dubai

By the Messify team · Updated November 2026 · 5 min read

Quick answer

Every Messify meal is 100% halal, every day, for every meal, with a vegetarian option at each one. Meals are cooked fresh daily in our partner kitchen in International City and delivered across nine areas of Dubai, from Academic City and Silicon Oasis to Jebel Ali and Dubai South, from AED 25 a meal.

Why halal matters when you choose a meal plan

For many people in Dubai, halal isn't a preference you weigh against price or taste. It's the first filter. When you eat out you can usually see where food comes from and ask about it. A meal plan is different: you hand over two or three meals a day, every day, to one kitchen you may never visit. So it's worth knowing exactly what you are signing up for before you pay.

This guide explains what to check before choosing a halal meal plan in Dubai, and how Messify handles halal food on its plans.

What to check before you choose

Most food sold in the UAE is halal, but "most" is not the same as "every meal on your plan". These questions take two minutes to ask on WhatsApp or by email, and any provider should be happy to answer them:

  • Is every meal halal, or only some? Some plans mix in imported or speciality items. Ask whether the whole menu is halal, every day.
  • Where is the food cooked? Knowing the kitchen and its location tells you who is responsible for what ends up in your bag.
  • Are any ingredients a concern for you? If you avoid things such as alcohol used in cooking, gelatine or certain flavourings, ask about them by name.
  • What happens if you have a question about a dish? You want a real person who can answer, not a form that disappears.

How Messify handles halal food

Every Messify meal is 100% halal. There is no separate halal menu to pick from and no option to switch off: the whole menu is halal, every day, for every meal.

All meals are cooked fresh daily in our partner kitchen in International City, Dubai. The menu changes every day, and you can see it in the Messify app before you choose. If you want to know more about a dish or an ingredient, message us on WhatsApp and someone on our team will answer.

Halal and vegetarian, every day

Alongside the halal menu, there is a vegetarian option every day, for every meal: breakfast, lunch and dinner. That helps if you share a plan with a vegetarian housemate or colleague, if you simply want a lighter day, or if you'd rather not eat meat on a particular day. The kitchen cooks both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.

How a halal meal plan works with Messify

  1. Choose a plan in the Messify app: 1, 2 or 3 meals a day, weekly or monthly.
  2. Pick tomorrow's meals by 6 PM. The menu changes daily, so you choose from the next day's dishes.
  3. Get your bag. Your meals arrive together in one chilled bag, at your home, residence or office.
  4. Keep them cold and reheat when you're ready to eat.

Each meal on your plan is a token. If you're away or eating with family one day, skip it in the app and use that meal on another day of your plan.

What it costs

Halal is standard on every plan, so there is no extra charge for it. Prices start from AED 25 a meal:

  • Weekly: AED 215, 415 or 610 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day (7 days of meals to use within 9 days).
  • Monthly: AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day (26 days of meals to use within 30 days).

That works out at AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal, depending on the plan. Our meal plan cost guide compares this with ordering in.

Where Messify delivers

Messify delivers halal meal plans to nine areas of Dubai:

  • Dubai Academic City, including university residences
  • Dubai Silicon Oasis, for homes and offices
  • International City, where our meals are cooked, and neighbouring Al Aweer
  • Dubai Festival City, including Al Badia
  • Jebel Ali and JAFZA, Dubai Investments Park and Dubai South, for offices, sites and homes
  • Al Furjan, for villas and apartments

Students, working professionals and families in these areas use a plan so the question of "what's for lunch, and is it halal?" is answered before the day begins.

How to start

Orders aren't taken on this website. Download the Messify app and choose your plan there, or message us on WhatsApp and our team will help you pick one. See all plans and prices on our meal plans in Dubai page, or start your plan.

Planning an event rather than everyday meals? Our catering menus are 100% halal too.

Questions people ask

Are Messify meal plans halal?

Yes. Every Messify meal is 100% halal, every day, for every meal. There is no separate halal menu: the whole menu is halal.

Where is the food cooked?

All meals are cooked fresh daily in our partner kitchen in International City, Dubai.

Is there a vegetarian option on a halal meal plan?

Yes. There is a vegetarian option every day, for every meal. The kitchen cooks both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.

Does a halal meal plan cost more?

No. Halal is standard on every Messify plan. Prices start from AED 25 a meal, with weekly plans from AED 215 and monthly plans from AED 715.

Which areas do you deliver halal meal plans to?

Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City, Dubai Festival City (DFC), Al Aweer, Dubai Investments Park (DIP), Jebel Ali (including JAFZA), Al Furjan and Dubai South.
